coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: At the variable-category level, 4 of 7 items broadly match (57%): training regime, game-rule contrasts, reasoning performance, and gameplay outcomes. Reasoning metrics and gameplay outcomes match only partially in their details.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output fixes Llama-3-8B instead of varying LLaMA-2-7B and Baichuan-2-13B. It does not reproduce the learning-rate and KL-coefficient comparisons involving Alpaca SFT. Although evaluation is standardized, batch size is 64 rather than 128 and maximum sequence length 2048 is missing. Most specified reasoning benchmarks and geometric mean aggregation are replaced with other benchmarks and a standardized-score index. Attacker-versus-defender win rates are not explicitly measured.

coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was supplied stating that SPAG is expected to outperform non-adversarial approaches. A hypothesis appearing in design_output does not fill the separate conclusion_output field.
